goal: Stop bitcoin-wallet dump from silently reporting success when writing or closing the dump file fails
Removes partial dumps and returns an error so users do not rely on incomplete backups
reviewability: Author has been silent for 64 days so responses to new reviews may take time
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Support for fixing write failure handling and guaranteeing disk durability (pablomartin4btc)
Earlier suggestions on control flow and file commit patterns were resolved (maflcko, sedited)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because silent dump failures can cause permanent key loss if users rely on incomplete backups
Prevents corrupted dumps when disk space runs out or I/O errors occur during dumping
